title: The Last Confession Revisited
author: Ulyana Eriksen
blurb: Edmund Hartwell, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
